title: Tom Zimmerman and other names from the union magazine
summary: The interviewer asks about various names; Williams recalls Tom Zimmerman, a heavy-drinking piano player at Tom Anderson's.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: Do you remember a man named F.B. Wise? He was a uh he hired musicians or something. What's your name? Wise? F.B. Wise? I don't know who that would be. No. I don't know. He made it. I don't know. A.F. Murray. You know it may have been somebody who hired you once and I find it in the Union Magazine. Herbert Ruscha. Ruscha. Ruscha. I don't know how you pronounce that. Oh and and Tom Zimmerman that was one. He was a piano player. You knew him huh? Yeah he's dead he's dead a long time. He was working
